repositories.name: SearXNG (Private Metasearch)
repositories.primary_metric: Privacy-respecting metasearch proxying 70+ engines with zero user tracking or ad profiling
repositories.production_tradeoff: Requires upstream engine IP rate-limit rotation or dedicated residential egress proxies

repositories.name: Perplexica / Vane (AI Answer Engine)
repositories.primary_metric: Self-hosted AI search agent with SearXNG integration and local Ollama/vLLM LLM inference
repositories.production_tradeoff: Multi-container Docker setup requires local SearXNG instance and embedding model runtime

repositories.name: BrowserOS (Agentic Search Browser)
repositories.primary_metric: Open-source agentic browser and search alternative to ChatGPT Atlas and Perplexity Comet
repositories.production_tradeoff: Active tab agent execution consumes local system RAM and headless browser cycles

repositories.name: Morphic (Generative UI Search)
repositories.primary_metric: AI search engine with generative UI components, interactive charts, and real-time citation cards
repositories.production_tradeoff: Default configuration uses cloud search APIs (Tavily/SearXNG) and OpenAI-compatible endpoints

repositories.name: MindSearch (Multi-Agent Research)
repositories.primary_metric: Graph-based multi-agent search framework executing 300+ parallel web queries for complex deep research
repositories.production_tradeoff: Multi-agent tree search incurs 10-25s response latency for exhaustive multi-hop synthesis
